description: E2EE crypto layer: ECDH P-256 key generation, HKDF-SHA-256 key derivation with roomId salt, AES-GCM-256 encrypt/decrypt. Creates apps/web/src/lib/crypto.ts with all cryptographic primitives needed for end-to-end encryption.
steps: 1. Create apps/web/src/lib/crypto.ts with generateKeyPair() function: Uses crypto.subtle.generateKey('ECDH', P-256 curve) to create key pair. Returns { publicKey: CryptoKey, privateKey: CryptoKey }.
2. Add exportPublicKey(publicKey: CryptoKey): Promise<JsonWebKey> to crypto.ts. Uses crypto.subtle.exportKey('jwk', publicKey).
3. Add importPublicKey(jwk: JsonWebKey): Promise<CryptoKey> to crypto.ts. Uses crypto.subtle.importKey('jwk', jwk, { name: 'ECDH', namedCurve: 'P-256' }, false, []).

4. Add deriveSharedSecret(privateKey: CryptoKey, peerPublicKey: CryptoKey, roomId: string): Promise<CryptoKey> to crypto.ts. Uses crypto.subtle.deriveKey with ECDH deriveBits, then HKDF-SHA-256 with roomId as salt. Returns AES-GCM-256 key.

5. Add encryptMessage(key: CryptoKey, plaintext: string): Promise<EncryptedEnvelope> to crypto.ts. Generates random IV (12 bytes), encrypts with AES-GCM, returns { iv: base64, ciphertext: base64, tag: included in ciphertext }.
6. Add decryptMessage(key: CryptoKey, envelope: EncryptedEnvelope): Promise<string> to crypto.ts. Decodes base64 IV and ciphertext, decrypts with AES-GCM, returns plaintext string.
7. Add TypeScript JSDoc comments to all functions explaining parameters and return values.

8. Test: Create apps/web/src/lib/__test-e2ee__.ts with a test function that generates two key pairs, derives shared secrets on both sides, encrypts a message with one key, decrypts with the other, and logs success/failure. Export testE2EE() function to call from browser console.
acceptance_criteria: crypto.ts exports generateKeyPair, exportPublicKey, importPublicKey, deriveSharedSecret, encryptMessage, decryptMessage
deriveSharedSecret uses roomId as HKDF salt to ensure different rooms have different keys even with same peer keys
encryptMessage produces EncryptedEnvelope matching protocol type (iv, ciphertext as base64 strings)
decryptMessage successfully decrypts envelopes produced by encryptMessage
Test function in __test-e2ee__.ts demonstrates round-trip encryption between two simulated peers
TypeScript compilation succeeds with no errors
verification: Manual browser test: Open browser console, import { testE2EE } from './lib/__test-e2ee__', run testE2EE() and verify console logs show successful encryption/decryption
findings: Implementation complete. crypto.ts exports all required functions: generateKeyPair, exportPublicKey, importPublicKey, deriveSharedSecret, encryptMessage, decryptMessage. HKDF-SHA-256 uses roomId as salt for key isolation. Test harness __test-e2ee__.ts includes round-trip test and room isolation verification. TypeScript compilation passed with no errors. Manual browser test pending user verification.
